stories.title: Large fire breaks out at Citrus County Landfill on Sunday
stories.summary: Firefighters successfully prevented the blaze from reaching the landfill liner, which helps keep contaminated liquids from entering soil and groundwater.

stories.title: 19-year-old man killed in Polk County head-on crash was not wearing seatbelt, deputies say
stories.summary: Polk County deputies say a 19-year-old driver was killed after crossing into oncoming traffic and hitting a pickup truck head-on.

stories.title: St. Pete-Clearwater airport officially names new deputy director
stories.summary: Croop succeeds Mark Sprague, who was promoted to airport director in March 2026.

stories.title: Clearwater motorcyclist accused of fleeing traffic stop at more than 100 mph while impaired
stories.summary: The deputy recorded the man speeding at 98 mph in a 30 mph zone, records state.

stories.title: 'I'll kill you one day': St. Petersburg man charged with electronic threats to kill ex-girlfriend
stories.summary: The man called his ex-girlfriend more than 450 times in two days, according to an arrest affidavit.

stories.title: Pinellas man arrested on 'Super Speeder' charge, claimed he was not speeding: affidavit
stories.summary: Pinellas Park police clocked the man traveling at 101 mph.

stories.title: FAA ground stop fallout continues at Tampa International Airport as passengers face delays, cancellations
stories.summary: Travelers continued facing disruptions as airlines recover from the recent FAA ground stop, with many flights delayed or canceled and passengers stranded.

stories.title: What is L3Harris? What we know about the Florida-based contractor linked to the nationwide FAA outage
stories.summary: The company has been awarded billions of dollars in federal government contracts and has worked to modernize the FAA’s telecommunications infrastructure for decades.

stories.title: 71-year-old Sarasota man killed in tractor-trailer crash, woman in critical condition
stories.summary: The car became trapped under the tractor-trailer, Florida Highway Patrol says.

stories.title: Man dies after crashing, walking across I-4 in Tampa: FHP
stories.summary: FHP says the man lost control of his vehicle before crashing and attempting to walk across the highway.

stories.title: Sarasota police search for driver who hit, killed 25-year-old Bradenton man
stories.summary: The man was found unconscious in the road.

stories.title: Driver hospitalized after 2-vehicle crash involving Polk County Fire Rescue engine
stories.summary: The driver of the car involved in the crash was transported, officials say. No injuries were reported to fire rescue officials.
